title: Question 28
passage:
The bus is running, but the stop outside the bakery is closed for roadwork.
A. They finished repaving the bakery's parking lot. B. The last bus leaves downtown at eleven. C. We can catch the same bus one block farther down.
passageZh:
公車還有開，但麵包店外的站牌因道路施工暫停使用。
A. 麵包店的停車場已經重新鋪好了。
B. 末班車十一點從市中心發車。
C. 再往前一個街區就能搭同一路公車。
